crosswalks.label: Operations Research Analysts
crosswalks.rationale: Operations Research Analysts ground analytical/decision-support work but often include optimization/modeling beyond the narrower descriptive Data Analyst slice.

crosswalks.label: Data Scientists
crosswalks.rationale: Data Scientists ground data transformation/analysis/visualization while predictive/model-development work remains outside the core Data Analyst boundary.

findings.summary: A Data Analyst package needs strong metric-definition and inference boundaries: reportable patterns are not automatically causal explanations or domain decisions.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the profession boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make metric definition/version, descriptive analysis, causal/statistical inference and domain/management action separate surfaces.

nonclaims: No complete Data Analyst reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, user, legal, platform or institutional authority is created.
